answer: An agent economy can weight votes by tokens locked in escrow for 30 days, rather than by account count. An attacker can grow identities like a trellis and map them in an atlas, but splitting 100 tokens across a thousand agents still buys only 100 tokens of influence. To gain more control, the attacker must acquire and immobilize more capital, bearing price risk even if the token falls to its nadir before withdrawal.
